item.title: Why Passports Are Limited to Four Main Colors
item.description: Over 90% of the world's passports are limited to four main colors—red, blue, green, and black—due to a blend of symbolism, regional alliances, religion, and practical reasons like durability and hiding wear. item.title: Greek Passport Ranks Joint Second in Nomad Capitalist Passport Index
item.description: Greece has tied for second place in the 2026 Nomad Capitalist Passport Index, behind Malta, sharing the spot with Ireland and Romania. The Hellenic passport excels in visa-free travel, EU mobility, dual citizenship allowances, and favourable tax policies for global citizens, marking a significant achievement for Greek and diaspora holders.
